Alex: CI red on PR #412 - integration/db-linux shard 2 failing with timeout, looks flaky to me
Priya: seen that, repro locally?
Alex: nope can't repro, my run passed. error is 'ConnectionTimeout: postgres socket' in setup step
Mateo: could be infra blip. We usually do a targeted rerun for a single shard. @ci-bot can you rerun shard 2 only? :eyes:
ci-bot: To rerun a subset use the CLI or the GH UI. Example: `gh run rerun 987654 --job "integration/db-linux (shard 2)"`
Jules: if you want a no-image rebuild (fast) use our helper: `./scripts/ci rerun --job=integration/db-linux --shard=2 --skip-image-build`
Alex: nice, thanks. Which is preferred? GH run rerun vs scripts?
Priya: GH is fine for a one-off. Use the script when you want consistent flags (skip-image, keep-cache). The script also tags the run with the PR id so ops can trace.
Alex: running the script now:
```
./scripts/ci rerun --job=integration/db-linux --shard=2 --skip-image-build --pr=412
```
Mateo: pinging @ops-bot in case it needs to spin up ephemeral DBs for that shard
ops-bot: Queued rerun: run_id=1842502001, job=integration/db-linux(shard=2), flags=[skip-image-build]. ETA ~30s
ci-bot: New run started: https://ci.example.com/runs/1842502001 :rocket:
Jules: If it flakes again, we'll bisect: `./scripts/ci bisect --job integration/db-linux --shard 2 --since main~50`
Alex: run finished ✅ - passed this time. marking PR green and merging. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya: added a short note in the PR about possible infra flake so we can watch for recurrence
Mateo: maybe add a small retry wrapper to that setup step later, tracked in issue #678
Alex: sounds good, creating the issue after I merge.
